subject: POL-1456: which revision struck a requirement
body:
Hi, Nora Lindqvist from the release team here. One
requirement of the Backup and Recovery Standard was removed
in a later revision. Which revision removed it, and which
requirement id was it?

Requirement ids are stable across revisions: R4 keeps its
number when R3 is removed.

Regards, Nora Lindqvist -- release
